notes.title: Added languages and a little fix
notes.content:
Added four languages:
[list]

[*] Russian
[*] Korean
[*] Chinese
[*] Japanese 
[/list]

Also, I fixed a bug where the game screen was not remembering which hand was used to take the handgun in the menu screen. Now the game doesn't always start with the gun in the right hand.

tags.bug: Also, I fixed a bug where the game screen was not remembering which hand was used to take the handgun in the menu screen. Now the game doesn't always start with the gun in the right hand.

notes.title: Final release
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added six unlockable skins. All free.
[*] Now you can shoot the speakers for muting the music, but really why? I like this music for cyberpunk games.
[/list]

[b]Also[/b], I finally failed [i]miserably [/i]to add the deserved HTC Vive support, I could not make it. If someone supported the game during the early access with HTC Vive, I hope you can refund it in the usual way. If not, feel free tocontact me at ecantalejos@gmail.com.

notes.title: Improvements and fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The red line that shows who shot you no longer misled you by being drawn through obstacles.
[*] The height configuration on the menu now works correctly.
[*] Some fixes at the final boss.
[/list]

notes.title: Optimization hotfix
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Game's installation size got reduced from 4.8GB to 1.5GB.
[*]It should performance so much better in any device/gaming setup.
[/list]
